title: Re-Entry Reduction on Extensions After a Suspension — Work Conditioning and Work Hardening
content:
# Re-entry reduction after a suspension

**Rule.** On an extension of the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program under a Workers' Compensation Referral, the re-entry reduction is two (2) days where the referral's latest suspension began no more than fourteen (14) calendar days before the request, one (1) day where it began fifteen to thirty (15 to 30) calendar days before, and none otherwise.

The latest suspension is the one whose start date is on file on the referral; a referral with no suspension start date on file has no re-entry reduction.

## Bands

| Latest suspension began, before the request | Re-entry reduction |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 calendar days | 2 days |
| 15 to 30 calendar days | 1 day |
| more than 30 calendar days, or no suspension on file | none |

## Boundary cases

| Suspension began | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 14 days before | 2 days |
| 15 days before | 1 day |
| 30 days before | 1 day |
| 31 days before | none |
